raw.buffDescription: Whichever Champion lands the first hit will place a Curse on the opposing Champion which deals 0.50% of their current Health as Direct Damage per second. Whenever a Champion with the Curse strikes the other Champion or if the Curse has been on the same Champion for 10 seconds, it passes to the other Champion.
